summary: Modules should hold most of the logic for a resource rather than thinly wrapping an API; split large APIs into several modules. If nothing existing fits, the page lists next steps for developing a module.
questions: Why would a thin API wrapper module be rejected?
How should I structure modules for a large API?

answer_card.title: Module scope and next steps
answer_card.answer_md: A module should contain most of the logic for interacting with its resource. A thin API wrapper pushes too much logic into playbooks and would be rejected; instead create multiple modules for smaller pieces of the API. If no module, action plugin or role covers your case, proceed to module development.
